rules.title: Health Safety Net: free to 150% FPL, with a deductible to 300%
rules.plain: Massachusetts residents with income up to 150% of the poverty line may get hospital bills paid by the Health Safety Net with no deductible, and up to 300% with a deductible. It can also pay after other insurance.
rules.quote: Massachusetts residents with income between 0-150% of the FPL may be eligible for the Health Safety Net.
rules.notes: A state program (apply through MassHealth), not a hospital policy. It pays acute hospital and community health center facility charges; doctors who bill separately may not be covered.
